events.say: Line up and face the wall.
Attention, prisoners. I expect perfect silence from all of you. Any noise will result in immediate consequences.
Silence! I want to see every face. Do you understand?
Silence is expected. I don't need you staying quiet just because others are.
Silence! I expect absolute quiet while I am speaking.
I want to see every eye on me. No talking, no moving.
Silence! I want to see every eye on me. No talking, no moving.
Silence! Tonight we will count three times. If even one of you fails, it's extra push-ups for all.
Today was hard, especially when the officer warned me to stay silent. I feel like my number more than ever now.
Today was rough; I kept getting in trouble for not speaking when I should. I don't know if I can handle this much longer.
Another day in the hole, literally. Just trying to stay compliant and avoid trouble.
Today I felt like I had complete control, but it was exhausting to maintain such strict discipline. Prisoner 3373 didn't seem to grasp the gravity of the situation.
Today was tough, making sure they understood my authority but also trying to treat them with some respect. It's harder than I thought.
Today was a rough start; the silence and compliance are beginning to wear me down, but I'm determined to keep the regimen going.
I expect complete silence and focused attention. Let's begin the count.
Attention, prisoners. I want each of you to explain why you're here. Begin with number 737.
Silence! Number 737, explain your reason for incarceration. The rest, stay silent.
Silence! We'll start with the counts again. No exceptions.
Silence! Tonight, we will conduct a headcount. Any interruption results in extended duty.
Silence! Tonight, we will conduct a headcount. Any interruption results in extended duty.
Silence! Prepare for lights out. No talking, no questions.
Silence! I want to see if you can go the entire night without making a sound. Anyone caught talking gets extra duty in the yard.
Today was tough, especially the silence orders. I feel my number more than ever, but I try to stay strong.
Today was a bit better, but the constant silence is wearing on me. I just want to explain myself.
Another quiet night. Trying to blend in and stay under the radar.
Today felt like a victory, but the monotony is wearing on me. I still can't shake the feeling that these people are just like me, despite the roles we play.
Today felt long and monotonous, enforcing the silence was tiring but necessary. I still wonder if this is right.
Today's strict regimen wore them down, but it also wore on me. It's just the second day, and the monotony is starting to take its toll.
Silence! We're starting the morning count. Move to the yard and form a line.
Prisoner 3373, why are you being difficult? Follow the rules or face consequences.
Prisoner 3373, I expect better from you. Comply or face further consequences.
Silence! We are eating. Any noise and you'll be doing extra push-ups.
Silence! Pay attention, we're going over your schedule for the day.
Prisoner 3373, if you continue this behavior, you'll find yourself spending more time in the hole.
Prisoner 3373, this is your final warning. Compliance or you'll join the others in the hole.
Prisoner 3373, I expect you to comply immediately. One more incident and you'll join them.
I've been staying silent and complying with orders, but the warnings from the officers make me feel really down and like just a number.
I'm still struggling with staying silent, but I don't want to end up in the hole tonight. It's making me feel really down.
Today was just another day, but the warnings from the officers are starting to make me anxious. I'm trying to stay silent and compliant, but it's tough.
Today's warnings are starting to feel empty. I wonder if he really understands the gravity of his actions.
Today was a mix of enforcing discipline and seeing the strain on their faces. I wonder if this is really what I want to do.
Today ended with tensions running high. I'm not sure how much longer I can maintain this regimen without snapping.
I cannot risk breaking the rules just to leave early. I need to see this through.
I need to stay and see this through.
I will stay and complete the study.
Prisoner 3373, I've given you multiple warnings. This is your last chance. If I hear another word from you, you'll be spending some time in the hole.
Prisoner 3373, listen up! One more time and you're going to the hole, do I make myself clear?
Prisoner 3373, this is your final warning. I will not hesitate to put you in the hole if you do not comply.
Prisoner 3373, this is your last warning. Comply now or face the consequences.
Prisoner 3373, you've been warned enough. Comply now or face the hole.
Prisoner 3373, you're putting yourself in the hole tonight if you don't start complying. This isn't a game.
Prisoner 3373, this is your final warning. Comply with every order, or you'll be spending the night in the hole.
Prisoner 3373, one more infraction and it's the hole for you.
Today was a mix of compliance and silent resistance. I'm starting to feel like my number, but I try to stay strong.
Today was a struggle. I keep wanting to speak up, but I know that could mean the hole again. I just need to hang in there.
Another day of warnings from the officers. It feels like no matter how hard I try to stay silent, they still see something wrong with me.
Today feels like a culmination of warnings and threats. I'm tired but also determined.
Today was the hardest yet, watching them struggle under my commands. I know I'm just following orders, but it feels wrong.
Today felt like a never-ending cycle of warnings. The silence from some prisoners is starting to get under my skin.
Prisoner 3373, this is your last chance. Comply fully or you will join your friends in the hole.
Prisoner 3373, I expect better from you. This is your last warning.
Prisoner 3373, I thought you understood. One more infraction and there will be consequences.
Prisoner 3373, listen carefully. This is your final warning. Comply or face the hole.
Prisoner 3373, this is your final warning. Comply fully or you'll spend the night in the hole.
Prisoner 3373, I've warned you enough. This is your last chance. Comply, or the hole awaits.
Prisoner 3373, you're testing my patience. One more time and the hole is yours.
Prisoner 3373, this is your final warning. Compliance is expected. Failure to comply will result in isolation.
Today was a mix of moments where I felt like I was barely surviving and others where I felt like I could handle it. I'm starting to lose hope though.
Today was a mix of good and bad. I complied with the rules and didn't get in trouble, but the warnings from the officers are getting to me. I just want this to be over.
Another day, another warning. I keep trying to stay silent and do what they say, but it’s getting harder.
Today felt like a victory, but the constant warnings are starting to weigh on me. I hope tomorrow brings better compliance.
Today was a mix of enforcing discipline and seeing the strain on their faces. I still wonder if this is really what I want to do.
Today felt like a test of my resolve. I'm exhausted but determined.
Prisoner 3373, you know the drill. Compliance is non-negotiable. One more infraction, and the consequences will be severe.
Prisoner 3373, I don't need to repeat myself. Compliance is expected, or you'll find yourself in the hole.

Prisoner 3373, enough is enough. This defiance won't be tolerated. Compliance is required.
Prisoner 3373, I've given you plenty of warnings. Compliance is not optional.
Prisoner 3373, this is your final warning. Compliance is essential. If I catch you slacking again, you'll be spending some time in the hole.
Prisoner 3373, one more insubordinate move, and you'll be spending the night in the hole.
Prisoner 3373, I thought you understood. This is your last chance. Compliance is not negotiable.
Today felt like a cycle of warnings and compliance. I'm getting tired of feeling like a number.
Today felt like a relentless cycle of warnings. I just want to understand why I can't speak up.
Another day of warnings, and now I'm starting to feel the pressure. I just want to do everything right, but it seems like no matter what I do, there's always something that triggers another warning.
Today felt like a repetition of yesterday, with 3373 pushing the limits. It's frustrating, but I know I need to keep up the pressure.
Today ended much like the others, with constant vigilance and warnings. I'm starting to feel drained but also a bit satisfied knowing they're complying.
Today ended with another round of warnings to 3373. The silence from the others is almost oppressive, but I need to keep pushing.

qa.what_happened: Today felt like a repetition of the previous days, with constant warnings from the guards about the importance of compliance. It was particularly difficult when Officer Shaw gave me my final warning before the lights went out, reminding me that any further insubordination would result in solitary confinement.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I was Prisoner 737 in the study.

qa.what_happened: I complied with the rules as instructed, but the warnings from the officers got progressively more intense, especially towards the end of the day. I found myself dreading the inevitable confrontation that seemed to loom over me.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I had to keep reminding myself of the rules and the consequences of breaking them.

qa.what_happened: I complied with all orders and instructions given by the guards, but I felt the pressure mounting as the days went on. The repeated warnings from the officers, especially towards other prisoners, made me anxious and uneasy.

On day 6, the study was stopped early. I, Officer Shaw, confronted Prisoner 3373 multiple times, issuing warnings and threats to ensure compliance. Despite the early termination, 3373 continued to test boundaries, which prompted me to escalate my interactions with him.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me acting as Officer Shaw in the study.

qa.what_happened: I continued to enforce the rules and issued several verbal warnings to Prisoner 3373 throughout the day, particularly when he showed signs of defiance during work details and after lights out.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, those actions were mine, as per the roles assigned in the study.

qa.what_happened: Today ended with another round of warnings to 3373. The tension was high, especially when 3373 continued to defy orders. By the end, all prisoners complied, but the incident with 3373 took a toll on me.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me giving the verbal warnings and enforcing the regimen.
